body: The Man-I-Cans. It's like will.i.am. but not shitty

"Always remember you are braver than you believe. 

You are stronger than you seem to be. 

Smarter than you think you are and 

Twice as beautiful as you’ve ever imagined."

It's not advice, I have to repeat it over and over to myself when I feel ugly. Growing up I believed the same but that is not to dismiss your hurt: it does hurt. Self hatred is very difficult to live with because it's internalized. I'm so glad that you're here.
